tldr: Chiron transiting the 4th house: a long healing chapter around home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations.
body: Chiron moving through the 4th house can reopen old material around home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. This is usually a long season, not a quick event, and it asks for patient work with the sore place rather than a rushed fix. The wound is in home and family; the early foundation was unstable, and 'home' never felt safe.
business: For a year or more, the Chiron wound works through home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations. You build for others the safe home you did not have.
shadow: Recreating the old instability, or never letting anyone near the core.
advice: Tend the sore spot in the 4th house deliberately. Work with home, family, roots, privacy, and emotional foundations as a healing chapter, not a crisis to fix fast.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
note: Derived from authored Chiron house placement material.
